description:
Base bundle: several reads in one paid call. Returns base_eth_getbalance and network_info_summary results in one paid call, keyed by part name. Returns: each named part service's own result, in one paid call, keyed by the part's name -- exactly what each part returns when bought alone; the call succeeds only when every part answers. It takes the union of the parts' query parameters.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_reads_bundle. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__base_reads_bundle
